Why wealthy people believe money itself is good, not bad.

Kevin Trudeau explains that wealthy people hold a few core beliefs, and the first one is that money itself is good.

He points out that the familiar saying is about the love of money, not money. In his view, what we believe about money shapes how we handle it.

What did you grow up hearing about money?

When someone pushes your buttons, it may be pointing at something useful.

Kevin Trudeau says the first question to ask is whether you responded or simply reacted. Usually, someone pushed a button.

He says that is the moment to say thank you, because something has come to the surface that you can clear out. In his words, the universe doesn't do things to us. It does things for us.

When did a hard moment last show you something about yourself?
